criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS FID 797 explicitly names BLDG_ABBR UC / University Church. Independently transformed 20-vertex GIS outline has bounds [[296.3565827428268, 347.2111957642118], [-162.1550495182555, -119.46780979172445]]; fresh-open shell bounds [[296.3565979003906, 347.211181640625], [-162.15504455566406, -119.46781158447266]]; max XY axis-bound error 0.000015 m. The state record and 2024 floor plan cross-check identity and use.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, scale and dimensions
criteria.evidence: Campus coordinates and GIS plan envelope match within 0.000015 m. The plan shape is present, but the portico/photo facade cannot be assigned to a GIS edge with the evidence available: the photo has no geotag/azimuth and floorplan has no north arrow/scale.
findings: Facade cardinal orientation remains inferred; source photo does not establish which GIS edge is the photographed entrance.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors and roof form
criteria.evidence: Source photo supports a slate gabled sanctuary roof and tower/spire silhouette; state record supports a multi-story facility. Eaves (11.7m), ridge (14.9m), spire (28.54m), and floor count remain estimates; GIS level fields conflict (Level_=4, NUM_LEVELS=1, CountOfFLO=3, Extrution=39 with undocumented units).
findings: No measured elevations or sufficiently scaled multi-view photo were found.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Direct comparison of saved preview with 2023 source supports red brick, four-column portico, triangular pediment with circular oculus, green spired tower, and arched side windows. Fresh-open probe confirms True oculus, 4 portico columns, True tower, 105 arched window-head objects. However, preview shows arches on the portico entrance elevation, while source photo shows rectangular/square-headed openings on the portico wall and arches on the perpendicular side wall; openings are generalized incorrectly across elevations. Facade compass placement is also inferred.
findings: Arched window heads extend across the displayed portico elevation, whereas source-visible windows on that elevation are rectangular; correct the distribution or explain with corroborating imagery.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: A separate Blender 5.2 background process opened the saved asset. Expected scene/collection present=True/True; 826 collection objects and 721 meshes; 40 shell vertices; no materialless meshes=True; unpacked external images=0; all five source snapshots and three previews exist. Asset SHA-256 1925045438dd01b022327dab66796a45e133b48f323ec6e4c6d6de9695e98877.
findings: Evidence record is detailed and self-contained, but final grade should be checked against the current saved revision after the window-head edits.
